# Two Location Pins Over Folded Map — reference review

- source: `pictographic-primitives/_uncategorized_26/map marks_4a6fa657-5f3d-4ab6-8949-77cda8ee6030.svg`
- source UUID: `4a6fa657-5f3d-4ab6-8949-77cda8ee6030`
- classification: side_combination
- review: pending_human_review

Two detached teardrop pins sit over a folded sheet as reusable location markers. Their points indicate positions and are not physical folds or printed map boundaries.

## Visual draft

Two teardrop pins sit at different heights over a wide folded map. Each has a circular opening, while the map's alternating upper and lower edges suggest three connected panels.

## 1. Wide folded map sheet (solo)

A wide folded map has three connected panels with alternating sloped top and bottom edges. Exclude both location pins.

## 2. Pair of location pins (sub)

Two teardrop location pins sit diagonally apart, each with a round opening and pointed base; the left one sits higher. Exclude the folded sheet.
